verses.1:
For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. + 46:1 Alamoth is probably a musical or liturgical term; here and in 1 Chronicles 15:20|1CH 15:20 . A song.
 God is our refuge and strength,
 an ever-present help in times of trouble.
verses.2:
Therefore we will not fear,
 though the earth is transformed
 and the mountains are toppled
 into the depths of the seas,
verses.3:
though their waters roar and foam
 and the mountains quake in the surge.
 Selah
verses.4:
There is a river whose streams delight the city of God,
 the holy place where the Most High dwells.
verses.5:
God is within her; she will not be moved.
 God will help her when morning dawns.
verses.6:
Nations rage, kingdoms crumble;
 the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
verses.8:
Come, see the works of the LORD,
 who brings devastation upon the earth.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
